data.evaluation_fitting: allowed within declared tensor scope and budgets; benchmark-conditioned optimization, no unseen-data claim

action_space: Exactly 224 attention/MLP linear weights: q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj and down_proj in 32 layers. Each is either hash-identical dense B0 or two static BF16 factors U[m,r], V[r,n], applied as U(Vx), with rank a positive multiple of 8 and r*(m+n)<=m*n. No dense residual, added bypass or extra adapter is permitted. Search per-matrix ranks, calibration weighting, whitening/damping, truncation and sequential recovery of factor entries. Recovery updates one transformer block at a time.
artifact: BF16 safetensors holding U/V factors plus unchanged dense tensors, a ranks.json map, exact source/output tensor inventory and Work provenance. Judge installs task-owned FactorLinear modules in the frozen native Mistral graph; it never reconstructs and caches a dense UV product for inference.

score.full_score: C/C0 <= 0.60 and every quality/resource gate; C is actual BF16 weight/factor tensor payload bytes, including every frozen inference weight once.

lifecycle.solution: copy existing pinned B0 plus identity declarative manifest; no compression, fitting, training or evaluation
lifecycle.reference_setup: task-author B0 measurement once after acceptance, then frozen
lifecycle.work: all candidate construction and optional controls, including repetitions and discarded attempts
lifecycle.judge: candidate-only direct evaluation of shared materialized Work snapshot with Judge-only task tests
